title: W-9: stop adding operator and fleet detail to the tree (commit identity, runner host in release notes, home paths in notes)
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-9 (medium). Every commit from here is public. Commits carry the full name and employer email, release notes print the runner hostname and kernel, hook-written tracker notes carry absolute home paths, and the WCLI-84 record names another private product's hosting and bypass header mechanism. Quest-authored records are not hand-edited. The history half is the operator's decision (W-33, dec-0znz91e) and is not part of this task. Files: .github/workflows/release.yml, .claude/settings.json.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Commit identity moves to a GitHub noreply address
RUNNER_HOST and uname are dropped from the release notes
Tracker notes stop carrying absolute home paths
WCLI-84's cross-product reference is reworded through quest if the operator chooses
